title: Deadly Venom Vendetta
story: In the glitzy world of high-stakes cocktail parties, a wealthy industrialist was found lifeless at the grand entrance of their lavish mansion. The victim, Ezra Stone, was a notorious figure in the connoisseur society, renowned for his extravagant taste in rare wines and exotic spices. This ebony-skinned billionaire was renowned for his enigmatic persona.
crimeScene: The grand entrance of Ezra Stone's opulent mansion.
forensicClue: An unexpected residue of unknown green substance on the doorknob.
question: Who murdered Ezra Stone and how? Please provide motives.
options: Option A (Victim's Business Partner - Reason: Stolen trade secrets and disputed partnership)
Option B (Victim's Ex-wife - Reason: Hidden assets and emotional torture)
Option C (Greedy Neighbor - Reason: Disputed land inheritance)
Option D (Enigmatic Carpet Vender - Reason: Unsold valuable antique carpet)
